snippet.title: Christopher Morris - Cooking, Music & Home
snippet.description:
Welcome to my channel! I share recipes, home renovation projects, and everything I love: cooking, classic rock and pop music, British baking shows, mysteries, and family moments with Owen and Sophie.

New videos weekly featuring weeknight dinner ideas, home improvement tutorials, and my favorite discoveries.

Naperville, Illinois | christopher.morris@voissync.ai
